flags.title: Projects 101, Lesson 3: Build your first timeline
evidence_lines: Practice: open the sample project, select the **Timeline** tab, and set dates for the 6 launch tasks.
Check: your timeline should show 2 dependencies and end by week 4.
Knowledge check: Where do you find the Timeline? (a) Reports (b) the Timeline tab (c) Settings

flags.title: Plan work with the Timeline view
evidence_lines: ## Open the Timeline view

## Share a timeline
Select **Share** to give teammates view access to the Timeline.

flags.title: Enterprise kickoff workshop, module 2: Reporting
evidence_lines: Facilitator demo: go to **Reports > Export** and choose CSV to share the report with leadership.

flags.title: Set up approvals
evidence_lines: ## Add an approver
1. Open a task and select **Request approval**.
2. Choose one person as the approver.
3. The approver gets an email and can approve or reject.
Note: each approval step has exactly one approver.
